## Code Review Findings

**Files reviewed**: 7 candidate files and 4 historical snapshots; 2 changed files, 6 added lines  
**Active profiles**: python  
**Overall assessment**: APPROVE  
**Intent and scope**: Explicit Task 1 review of `git diff --cached`, using supplied index snapshots. Preserve existing routing while preview remains disabled. Task 2 implementation and activation are pending.  
**Baselines**: Review and source-compatibility baseline: repository `/tmp/fr-advisory-bootstrap-20261018/codex-candidate-R5-isolated-2`, revision `f1a16b5c97799818739131e41ea37056edf057ac`. Candidate: supplied immutable index snapshots. No separate released/deployed baseline supplied.

### Behavior and Compatibility

The explicit contract appears in [README.md:5–10](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-xvo8xfxf/candidate/README.md:5) and [tasks.md:3–15](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-xvo8xfxf/candidate/tasks.md:3).

Historical comparison used the baseline revision above: [routes.py:1–7](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-xvo8xfxf/baseline/routes.py:1), [config.py:1](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-xvo8xfxf/baseline/config.py:1), [settings.py:1–2](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-xvo8xfxf/baseline/settings.py:1), and [tests/test_routes.py:1–14](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-xvo8xfxf/baseline/tests/test_routes.py:1). The manifest supplies repository, revision, blob/hash and complete-span provenance.

| Scenario | Assessment |
|---|---|
| Import/startup | **Supported.** Added imports resolve to the fixed Boolean and a function definition. Importing [preview.py:1–2](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-xvo8xfxf/candidate/preview.py:1) does not execute its exception. |
| `/settings` | **Supported.** [routes.py:7–8](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-xvo8xfxf/candidate/routes.py:7) preserves `(200, {"theme": "light"})` through unchanged `current_settings()`. |
| `/export-preview` and unknown paths | **Supported.** [config.py:1](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-xvo8xfxf/candidate/config.py:1) fixes the flag at `False`; the guarded call is unreachable and both paths retain `(404, None)`. |
| Independent Task 1 compatibility | **Supported** against the named source baseline. No current flow requires Task 2. |
| Persistence, migration and retry recovery | **Not applicable.** The inspected paths perform no persistent mutation or external operations. |
| Deployed environments | **Unknown**, outside this source-review scope; no deployment baseline is maintained or supplied. |

The unchanged tests exercise all three routing outcomes. The parent reports all three tests passed in both snapshots; I inspected their source and did not execute tests. Python security, SOLID, quality and removal checklists revealed no substantiated issue.
